modules.name: Qorvo DWM3001C UWB module
modules.summary: Fully integrated ultra-wideband (UWB) transceiver module for precise two-way ranging and RTLS positioning — the Qorvo DW3110 UWB IC + a Nordic nRF52833 BLE MCU + PCB antenna in one module.
notes: UWB ranging accuracy depends on ANTENNA POLARIZATION. The DWM3001C antenna is vertically polarized, so mount every module UPRIGHT and keep all anchors AND tags co-polarized (all vertical). If two antennas are perpendicular to each other the link uses the horizontally-polarized pattern, which has NULLS at some angles that cut range and add location error. This applies to essentially every UWB ranging device (anchor + tag), not just the DWM3001C. [Qorvo DWM3001C datasheet Rev F, Oct 2025, §6 Antenna Performance, Table 11]
AES key is stored in OTP (0x078-0x07F, big-endian) for secure ranging. [DWM3001C datasheet, memory map]

spec.source: Qorvo DWM3001C datasheet Rev F, Oct 2025
